verdict.rationale: Circle documents broad REST API coverage across its products: wallets (user- and developer-controlled), Gateway, CCTP, smart contracts, StableFX, CPN and compliance screening, with per-product OpenAPI specs, webhooks, idempotency keys and a CLI covering wallet, transfer, swap, bridge and contract operations. Nothing in the pack compares this API surface to a UI or console, so parity with everything the UI can do is unproven. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or a mapping of console features to API endpoints, a unified discoverable OpenAPI spec (root-path probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
